name: Lavinia
description: Lavinia is an Azorius arrester from Ravnica who became Jace's deputy and later acting guildmaster of the Azorius Senate.

summary.text: Lavinia is an Azorius arrester from Ravnica who became Jace's deputy and later acting guildmaster of the Azorius Senate.

bio.text: After her brother Jek died paying for her safety, she killed the torturers and left to become an arrester.

citations.text: "Lavinia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She investigated and later arrested Jace as the Azorius maze runner, and when Jace became the first Living Guildpact she became his aide and deputy.

citations.text: "Lavinia", section "Mazerunner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Lavinia", section "Mazerunner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Lavinia", section "Mazerunner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: As his bailiff she kept the Chamber of the Guildpact running and guarded his secret that he was a planeswalker.

citations.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.
"Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

bio.text: During the War of the Spark Tezzeret placed a device on her neck, and the possessed Lavinia killed Hekara before Ral Zarek freed her.

citations.text: "Lavinia", section "Rebel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Lavinia", section "Rebel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She helped shut off the Immortal Sun after Dovin Baan was defeated and became acting guildmaster of the Azorius, then brought the Azorius into the plan to unite the guilds.

citations.text: "Lavinia", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After the New Phyrexian Invasion she reformed the Azorius, ridding it of Dovin Baan's influence, and led the investigation of Zegana's murder at Karlov Manor, where Oba captured her until Kaya and Etrata freed her.

citations.text: "Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Lavinia is alive and leads the Azorius Senate, and in the latest story she studies the Guildpact to find a way to arrest Oba.

citations.text: "Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: After the Supreme Verdict, the Chamber is built in Gateway Plaza on the ashes of Jace's former sanctum, and Jace tells Lavinia the site 'seemed fitting'.
timeline.quote: Seemed fitting,

citation.text: "Chamber of the Guildpact", section "Original construction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace collaborates with Niv-Mizzet, Gideon allies with Aurelia, and the Implicit Maze makes Jace the Living Guildpact with Lavinia as manager.
timeline.quote: The Implicit Maze moved Jace into the central Living Guildpact role

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lavinia's brother Jek dies paying for her safety; she kills the torturers and leaves to become an arrester.
timeline.quote: her brother ultimately paid for his sister's safety with his life.

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lavinia investigates Jace after an arson; Ruric Thar helps Jace escape and wounds arresters.
timeline.quote: Ruric Thar shrugged off the magic and wounded several of the arresters assigned to Lavinia.

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Arrester". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lavinia is reassigned to the towers of New Prahv to keep her out of the case.
timeline.quote: she was reassigned and confined in the towers of New Prahv

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Arrester". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lavinia is chosen to run the maze for the Azorius and arrests Jace at the Azorius Guildgate.
timeline.quote: Lavinia took the opportunity to, at last, arrest Jace

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Mazerunner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isperia sentences Jace to community service; Jace links the runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and becoming the first Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: empowered Jace as Ravnica's first Living Guildpact .

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Mazerunner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lavinia becomes Jace's aide and deputy.
timeline.quote: She became Jace's aide and deputy at the Chamber of the Guildpact .

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Mazerunner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives late at the Chamber of the Guildpact to find Boros minotaurs complaining that the Orzhov have violated a boundary contract.
timeline.quote: The Orzhov violated our boundary contract!

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Jace rules that the minotaurs must file a proper complaint with Lavinia, and the lead minotaur sheathes his axe.
timeline.quote: You will file a proper complaint with Deputy Lavinia

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Lavinia shows Jace that victims of petrification were found in Rozlad Square arranged to spell his name.
timeline.quote: They spell out your name.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Jace recognizes that the victims' names match planes, realizes a planeswalker is targeting him, and insists on going alone to Rozlad Square.
timeline.quote: Clear out all your officers and mages from Rozlad Square. I'm going alone.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Back at the Chamber, Lavinia reports the guilds now know of Vraska, and Jace, uneasy about Garruk, prepares to leave for a few days.
timeline.quote: And I think something's up with Garruk.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Jace finishes a day of tedious petitions as the Living Guildpact and returns to his secret apartments.
timeline.quote: "Guildpact," said Lavinia. He turned. "Get some rest."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana reflects that Jace swore Lavinia to secrecy about planeswalking, and Lavinia guards him to keep him from leaving.
timeline.quote: to swear her to secrecy

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals influential Azorius Senate members were petrified while he was away.
timeline.quote: a few influential members in the Azorius Senate were...eliminated.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Gideon to investigate the petrifications and work with the Azorius.
timeline.quote: I'd like you to investigate this.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace returns from his paperwork and Lavinia hands him tea, anticipating his needs.
timeline.quote: It's my job to anticipate you, Guildpact,

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Lavinia reports that Liliana and Chandra spent the afternoon in the market district and then planeswalked together.
timeline.quote: They spent the afternoon wandering the market district

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Lavinia stops Jace from leaving to find Chandra, saying Gideon and Nissa can search for Monk Nalaar.
timeline.quote: They can find Monk Nalaar.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark and Dovin Baan's flight, Lavinia becomes acting guildleader.
timeline.quote: Lavinia became acting guildleader.

citation.text: "Azorius Senate", section "Guilds of Ravnica storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lavinia refuses to recognize Dovin Baan's authority after Vraska assassinates Isperia and leads a rebel faction.
timeline.quote: she also refused to acknowledge Dovin Baan 's authority

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Rebel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret traps Lavinia and places a device on her neck, making her an unwilling accomplice of Bolas.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret outmatched her and placed a device on her neck

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Rebel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Possessed Lavinia kills Hekara before Ral Zarek frees her.
timeline.quote: This led to Hekara being killed by Lavinia

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Rebel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska's betrayal leads to Hekara's death at the hands of a possessed Lavinia.
timeline.quote: Vraska's betrayal led to the Rakdos emissary Hekara being killed by a Bolas-possessed Lavinia

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lavinia recalls telling Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he did not take his responsibilities seriously.
timeline.quote: I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously.

citation.text: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade (Ravnica Allegiance Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Nissa, Saheeli, Lavinia and Lazav shut off the Immortal Sun at New Prahv after defeating Dovin Baan, using Azor's nine words.
timeline.quote: Chandra managed to shut it off with the spell

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark Lavinia helps shut off the Immortal Sun after defeating Dovin Baan.
timeline.quote: They managed to do so after defeating Dovin Baan

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lavinia becomes acting guildmaster of the Azorius.
timeline.quote: She survived the War and became acting guildmaster of the Azorius.

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra to fight Dovin Baan, letting the real Chandra disable the Immortal Sun, then blinds Baan.
timeline.quote: He disguised himself as Chandra in the fight against Dovin Baan

citation.text: "Lazav", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan sabotages Ral's great machine, and Ral activates the Interplanar Beacon after defeating Vraska at the cost of Hekara's life.
timeline.quote: At the cost of Hekara's life, Ral was able to defeat Vraska and free Lavinia.

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "Changing the Implicit Maze". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra to distract Dovin Baan, letting Chandra disable the Immortal Sun, and Lazav defeats Baan.
timeline.quote: Lazav defeated Baan, blinding him with throwing stars and causing him to planeswalk away.

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ral, Kaya and Vraska conspire against Bolas, planning to make Niv-Mizzet the new Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Ral, Kaya, and Vraska conspire against Bolas, realizing the dragon's treacherous nature.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya's team wins over the neutral guilds, with Vraska returned and Hekara resurrected, and Lavinia brings the Azorius on board.
timeline.quote: With some help from a returned Vraska and a resurrected Hekara, they succeed.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo uses shields in battle, and the group learns most guilds have retreated or serve Bolas.
timeline.quote: The rest of the guilds have retreated to shore up their own territories, more suspicious of one another than of Bolas.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The guild representatives arrive; Lazav reveals he was disguised as Varryvort.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Lazav of House Dimir reveal that he had been there all along

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek reveals the plan is to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact, surprising several guild leaders.
timeline.quote: We are here to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The guilds assign Zarek to hunt Tezzeret, Vraska to hunt Dovin Baan, and hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: And Kaya, the ten guilds wish to hire you to assassinate Liliana Vess.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Lavinia reforms the Azorius during the New Phyrexian Invasion, ridding it of Dovin Baan's influence.
timeline.quote: ridding it of the last traces of Dovin Baan's influence.

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zegana is assassinated at Karlov Manor and Lavinia leads the investigation.
timeline.quote: she was present at Karlov Manor when Zegana was assassinated

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alquist Proft reveals Oba organized the murders; Oba attacks and captures Lavinia, who is freed when Kaya and Etrata defeat her.
timeline.quote: Lavinia was captured, but was freed after Oba was defeated by Kaya and Etrata.

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa explains that Ezrim leads the Agency after the invasion and has drawn away Azorius associates.
timeline.quote: Imagine her displeasure when after the invasion, he took on leadership.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Proft persuades Kellan not to fight the Azorius over the suspect.
timeline.quote: This is not the time to stand our ground

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Lavinia demands that the suspect be remanded to Azorius custody and Etrata is taken away.
timeline.quote: Remand the suspect to Azorius custody at once

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft argues the Guildpact exempts Etrata from consequences for her escape.
timeline.quote: I believe you'll find the Guildpact exempts her from any consequence for that action.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Lavinia agrees Proft and Etrata committed no crime.
timeline.quote: It'll take months to clear the paperwork, and I'm not happy about it, but yes, we're agreed

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba accuses Krenko of hoarding and price-gouging during the invasion.
timeline.quote: was hoarding resources

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Teysa explains she will ruin Selesnya financially rather than use the law, and asks Kaya to leave Ravnica.
timeline.quote: You'll have to leave, of course.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba's sisters enter meditation, leaving Emmara Tandris to lead; Kaya regrets not killing Oba and Teysa's ghost promises a punishing lawsuit.
timeline.quote: leaving Emmara Tandris to lead the guild.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hekara was killed by a Bolas-possessed Lavinia while saving Ral's life.
timeline.quote: she was killed by a Bolas-possessed Lavinia while saving her "mate" Ral's life

citation.text: "Hekara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jek and Vinni obtain a Dimir key and the Dimir organize Rakdos to hunt them.
timeline.quote: The Dimir wanted the key back and organized a band of Rakdos led by an albino man

citation.text: "Jek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakdos track them to their Ninth District apartment and they flee; Jek binds the Spike Jester.
timeline.quote: Jek then cast a binding glyph on the jester and kicked him away.

citation.text: "Jek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The albino and an ogre catch them; Jek is wounded and sliced across the chest.
timeline.quote: the albino managed to slice his chest with a blade

citation.text: "Jek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vinni stabs the albino and, with Jek's blue-fire dagger, kills the ogre.
timeline.quote: Vinni avenging him by stabbing the albino through his throat with her dagger

citation.text: "Jek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jek gives Vinni the key, tells her to be strong, and dies in her arms.
timeline.quote: told Vinni - Lavinia , as her full name was, to be strong, then died in her arms

citation.text: "Jek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Saheeli, Lazav and Lavinia enter New Prahv to deactivate the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: intending to deactivate the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "New Prahv", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
